Question: Isosceles trapezoid \(ABCD\) has parallel sides \(\overline{AD}\) and \(\overline{BC},\) with \(BC\lt AD\) and \(AB=CD.\) There is a point \(P\) in the plane such that \(PA=1,\) \(PB=2,\) \(PC=3,\) and \(PD=4.\) What is \(\dfrac{BC}{AD}?\)
